  • Methodendetails

    • read

      @NonNull OA read(@NonNull IA input)

      Performs a transition for the given input symbol and returns the associated output.

      Parameter:
      input - the input symbol
      Gibt zurück:
      the output associated with the input
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if input is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the input symbol is unknown
